description: Source code for hash functions and object ID definitions used in Git, including SHA1 and SHA256 hash implementations and related utilities.

methods.name: git_hash_sha1_init
methods.description: Initializes SHA1 hash context.

methods.name: git_hash_sha1_clone
methods.description: Clones SHA1 hash context.

methods.name: git_hash_sha1_update
methods.description: Updates SHA1 hash with data.

methods.name: git_hash_sha1_final
methods.description: Finalizes SHA1 hash and outputs digest.

methods.name: git_hash_sha1_final_oid
methods.description: Finalizes SHA1 hash and outputs object ID.

methods.name: git_hash_sha1_init_unsafe
methods.description: Initializes SHA1 hash context with unsafe method.

methods.name: git_hash_sha1_clone_unsafe
methods.description: Clones SHA1 hash context with unsafe method.

methods.name: git_hash_sha1_update_unsafe
methods.description: Updates SHA1 hash with data using unsafe method.

methods.name: git_hash_sha1_final_unsafe
methods.description: Finalizes SHA1 hash with unsafe method.

methods.name: git_hash_sha1_final_oid_unsafe
methods.description: Outputs object ID from unsafe SHA1 hash.

methods.name: git_hash_sha256_init
methods.description: Initializes SHA256 hash context.

methods.name: git_hash_sha256_clone
methods.description: Clones SHA256 hash context.

methods.name: git_hash_sha256_update
methods.description: Updates SHA256 hash with data.

methods.name: git_hash_sha256_final
methods.description: Finalizes SHA256 hash.

methods.name: git_hash_sha256_final_oid
methods.description: Outputs object ID from SHA256 hash.

methods.name: git_hash_unknown_init
methods.description: Handles initialization for unknown hash algorithms (triggers BUG).

methods.name: git_hash_unknown_clone
methods.description: Handles cloning for unknown hash algorithms (triggers BUG).

methods.name: git_hash_unknown_update
methods.description: Handles update for unknown hash algorithms (triggers BUG).

methods.name: git_hash_unknown_final
methods.description: Handles finalization for unknown hash algorithms (triggers BUG).

methods.name: git_hash_unknown_final_oid
methods.description: Outputs object ID for unknown hash algorithms (triggers BUG).

methods.name: hash_algo_by_name
methods.description: Returns hash algorithm index by name.

methods.name: hash_algo_by_id
methods.description: Returns hash algorithm index by format ID.

methods.name: hash_algo_by_length
methods.description: Returns hash algorithm index by digest length.

methods.name: unsafe_hash_algo
methods.description: Returns unsafe implementation of hash algorithm if available.
